chain_words.nuance: difficult to understand or deal with
twisted and needlessly hard to follow
so tangled that one easily loses the way

explanation: These words all describe something that is hard to follow, moving from having many connected parts to being so tangled that it is nearly impossible to navigate.

usage_notes.difference: 'Intricate' praises careful, admirable detail, while 'convoluted' suggests unnecessary complexity that makes something harder to follow.
